exposeDiagnosticMetrics.description: Expose self-introspection metrics for debugging the exporter itself (`x509_parse_duration_seconds`, `x509_kube_request_duration_seconds`, `x509_kube_informer_scope`, `x509_informer_queue_depth`). Off by default ; enable when you actually need to look inside.

exposeExpiredMetric.description: Expose `x509_cert_expired` (1 if the certificate is expired, 0 otherwise). On by default ; turn off to halve the per-cert series count if you only alert on `x509_cert_not_after - time()`.

exposeNotBeforeMetric.description: Expose `x509_cert_not_before` (Unix timestamp of the certificate's NotBefore). Off by default — most users only alert on expiry; enable if you specifically need to detect "issued in the future" misconfigurations or clock skew.

exposePerCertificateErrorMetrics.description: Enable additional metrics to report per-certificate errors ; helps with identifying the origin of read errors without having to look at exporter logs, at the expense of additional storage on Prometheus

exposeRelativeMetrics.description: Enable additional metrics with relative durations instead of absolute timestamps ; not recommended with Prometheus

extraDeployVerbatim.description: Same as `extraDeploy` but objects won't go through the templating engine

extraLabels.description: Additional labels added to all chart objects

extraVolumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts added to all Pod containers (see also the `secretsExporter` and `hostPathsExporter` variants)

extraVolumes.description: Additional volumes added to all Pods (see also the `secretsExporter` and `hostPathsExporter` variants)

hostNetwork.description: Enable hostNetwork mode. Useful when Prometheus is deployed outside of the Kubernetes cluster

affinity.description: Affinity for Pods of hostPath exporters (default for all hostPathsExporter.daemonSets)

daemonSets.description: [SEE README] Map to define one or many DaemonSets running hostPath exporters. Key is used as a name ; value is a map to override all default settings set by `hostPathsExporter.*`.

debugMode.description: Should debug messages be produced by hostPath exporters (default for all hostPathsExporter.daemonSets)

env.description:
Additional environment variables for containers
- name: GOMAXPROCS
value: "1"

extraVolumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts added to Pod containers of hostPath exporters (default for all hostPathsExporter.daemonSets ; combined with global `extraVolumeMounts`)

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe definition for the host paths exporter (.httpGet cannot be changed)

podAnnotations.description:
Annotations added to Pods of hostPath exporters (default for all hostPathsExporter.daemonSets)
type: object
additionalProperties: true
properties: {}

podSecurityContext.description: PodSecurityContext for Pods of hostPath exporters (default for all hostPathsExporter.daemonSets)

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe definition for the host paths exporter (.httpGet cannot be changed)

refreshInterval.description:
Polling interval at which the file source re-walks watched paths and re-parses changed files. Accepts a Go duration (e.g. `30s`, `5m`). Default is suited for slowly-rotated PKI; lower it for tests or fast-rotation flows.
enum: [Always]

resources.description: ResourceRequirements for containers of hostPath exporters (default for all hostPathsExporter.daemonSets)

restartPolicy.description:
restartPolicy for Pods of hostPath exporters (default for all hostPathsExporter.daemonSets)
type: object
additionalProperties: true

revisionHistoryLimit.description:
(int) Number of old ReplicaSets to retain for rollback (default for all hostPathsExporter.daemonSets)
type: object
additionalProperties: true
properties: {}

securityContext.description: SecurityContext for containers of hostPath exporters (default for all hostPathsExporter.daemonSets)

skipSymlinks.description: Skip symlinks when scanning files and directories. Does not apply to Kubernetes secrets.

tolerations.description:
Tolerations for Pods of hostPath exporters (default for all hostPathsExporter.daemonSets)
type: object
additionalProperties: true

updateStrategy.description:
updateStrategy for DaemonSets of hostPath exporters (default for all hostPathsExporter.daemonSets)
type: [integer, 'null']

watchKubeconfFiles.description: [SEE README] List of Kubeconf file paths of the host to scan for embedded certificates to export metrics about

imagePullSecrets.description: Specify docker-registry secret names as an array

metricLabelsFilterList.description: (list) Restrict metric labels to this list if set. **Warning** : use with caution as reducing cardinality may yield metrics collisions and force the exporter to ignore certificates. This will also degrade the usability of the Grafana dashboard. This list should always include at least `filepath`, `secret_namespace` and `secret_name`. Also `subject_CN` is highly recommended for when a file contains multiple certificates.

nameOverride.description: Partially override x509-certificate-exporter.fullname template (will prepend the release name)

podAnnotations.description:
Annotations added to all Pods
prometheus.io/port: "9793"
prometheus.io/scrape: "true"

podExtraLabels.description: Additional labels added to all Pods

podListenPort.description: TCP port to expose Pods on (whether kube-rbac-proxy is enabled or not)

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClassName set for all Pods by default (can be overridden with `secretsExporter` and `hostPathsExporter` specific values)

probeListenPort.description:
TCP port for a separate plain-HTTP server exposing only `/healthz`
and `/readyz`, used as the kubelet probe target. `0` disables it; the
chart auto-enables `8080` when the main `/metrics` port is auth-gated
(`webConfiguration` set or `rbacProxy.enabled`), so kubelet probes
can succeed without a TLS / mTLS / Bearer credential. Set explicitly
to override the auto-default.

create.description: Should a Service be installed, targeting all Deployment and DaemonSet instances (required for ServiceMonitor)

extraLabels.description: Additional labels to add to the Service

headless.description:
Should the Service be headless (`clusterIP: None`).
type: integer
minimum: 1
maximum: 65535

webConfiguration.description: HTTP server configuration for enabling TLS and authentication (password, mTLS) ; see [documentation at Exporter Toolkit](https://github.com/prometheus/exporter-toolkit/blob/master/docs/web-configuration.md)

webConfigurationExistingSecret.description: Load the HTTP server configuration from an existing Secret instead of `webConfiguration`. Key must be `webconfig.yaml`.
